title: USACE Inland Waterway Transit Constraint Resolver input

route.title: Route
route.description: Inland-waterway route you supply, as an ordered list of {"lat", "lon"} points (WGS84). The Actor does not plan routes; follow the channel closely enough for the corridor to cover it.

corridorNm.title: Corridor half-width (nautical miles)
corridorNm.description: Distance either side of the route within which notices and locks are matched. Default 1.

atTime.title: At time (UTC)
atTime.description: ISO 8601 time with timezone used for notice temporal status, e.g. 2026-10-12T15:00:00Z. Defaults to now. Lock operating conditions always reflect retrieval time.
